name: Development
description: Start the local development stack (PostgreSQL and Mailpit in Docker, FastAPI and Vite on the host) and run the project's checks, as described in development.md and backend/README.md.

actions.title: Services (db, mailpit)
actions.description: Runs PostgreSQL (localhost:5432) and Mailpit (UI localhost:8025, SMTP localhost:1025) with Docker Compose in the foreground. Stopping the action stops the containers; volumes are kept.

actions.title: Prepare database
actions.description: Runs Alembic migrations (upgrade head) and creates the initial data. Needs the db service. Writes to the database; uv installs backend dependencies on first use.

actions.title: Backend dev server
actions.description: Runs the FastAPI development server with reload at http://localhost:8000 (docs at /docs). Needs the db service and a prepared database. Stop the Compose stack first: both use port 8000.

actions.title: Frontend dev server
actions.description: Runs the Vite development server at http://localhost:5173. It calls the backend at http://localhost:8000 (frontend/.env). Needs `bun install` first.

actions.title: Full stack (Compose watch)
actions.description: Runs the whole stack in Docker Compose with file sync and rebuilds: app at http://localhost:8000, Adminer at :8080, Traefik UI at :8090, Mailpit at :8025. Run the prestart step in Compose first on a new database. Stopping the action stops the containers; volumes are kept.

actions.title: Backend lint (read-only)
actions.description: Runs backend/scripts/lint.sh: mypy, ty, ruff check, and ruff format --check on backend/app. Changes no files.

actions.title: Backend tests
actions.description: Runs backend/scripts/test.sh: pytest under coverage, then a coverage report and backend/htmlcov. Needs the db service and a prepared database; the tests write to that database.

actions.title: Frontend lint and fix
actions.description: Runs Biome on the frontend with --write --unsafe. This changes files to fix problems. Needs `bun install` first.

actions.title: Pre-commit hooks (all files)
actions.description: Runs every prek hook from .pre-commit-config.yaml on all files. Hooks can reformat and change files.
